Zoe (People Ops): Heads-up: Lina is US-based but traveling abroad until Day 1. She asked whether an authorized rep can do Section 2 of the I-9 while she's away.
Marcus (HR): Yes, we accept an authorized rep. Need signed delegation form, photos of the rep's ID + hires' docs, and an entry in the file noting rep name/contact.
Lina (New Hire): My partner is willing to be the rep and can meet the verifier at the coworking space on Tue local time. I can sign the delegation form now.
Zoe (People Ops): Great. I'll DM the delegation PDF and upload link. Quick steps: 1) Lina signs delegation and emails it to people-ops@redwood.example. 2) Rep completes Section 2, snaps front/back photos of documents and emails them. 3) We add records to BambooHR and mark I-9 complete.
Lina (New Hire): Done — I emailed the signed PDF and confirmed the rep slot for Tue 14:00 local.
Marcus (HR): Also flag: because Lina's role touches finance tools, Security requires a 10-min verification call with the rep to confirm IDs. Schedule that into the same meeting if possible.
Zoe (People Ops): Noted. I'll schedule a 15-min slot and invite Security + HR. BadgeBot: badge hold until original ID seen at pickup or rep authorization recorded.
IT Support: We will image the laptop Day 1 and provision standard apps. No elevated access until background check cleared. We'll tag the account as "bg-pending".
ClearCheck Bot: background-check: CONSENT_RECEIVED (1793001140). Vendor ETA: 72 hours. Potential fingerprint queue flagged.
Marcus (HR): Benefits enrollment goes live on hire date regardless of BG pending. Payroll will use the scheduled start date. Access to payroll systems is restricted until security clear.
Zoe (People Ops): Action items: 1) I run the verification call with rep Tue 14:00 local. 2) Attach rep photos + delegation form to Lina's HR record. 3) Monitor ClearCheck and escalate if >5 business days.
Lina (New Hire): Thanks everyone — I'll be on the call and will bring the paperwork to my partner.
Zoe (People Ops): I'll update the onboarding task once Section 2 and the security check are done. Closing note: keep this thread open until ClearCheck shows CLEARED.
